t: You're looking at the Meath Memorial, a monument to Reginald Brabazon, the twelfth Earl of Meath. He was an Irish politician and philanthropist, and this is the memorial that commemorates him. It was made by Joseph Hermon Cawthra, an English monumental sculptor. In his lifetime Cawthra was considered among the leading classical sculptors working in Britain, and he received several commissions for public monuments, war memorials and architectural sculpture.
